ev.q: During 2011–2012, on a given day, 14.5% of adults aged ≥20 years consumed the U.S. recommended 3 cups of dairy.
More men (19.0%) than women (10.3%) consumed the recommended 3 cups of dairy.

methods_quotes.q: Data from the Day 1 24-hour recall were used in this analysis.
